name: plan-limits
description: A weather forecast for your context window and your plan's 5-hour and weekly limits, with reset times, this session's cost and the last response's output speed, above the prompt; and a status line with the directory, model and effort under it

showContext.title: Show context
showContext.description: Show the context window: how much of it is used, with a bar and the token count on a wide line.

showFiveHour.title: Show 5-hour limit
showFiveHour.description: Show how much of the plan's 5-hour limit is left, with its reset time.

showWeek.title: Show weekly limit
showWeek.description: Show how much of the plan's weekly limit is left, with its reset time.

showCost.title: Show session cost
showCost.description: Show this session's cost at API prices, as /cost totals it.

showSpeed.title: Show output speed
showSpeed.description: Show the output speed of the last response, in tokens per second.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show the directory, model and effort under the prompt, in the Catppuccin colours, unless your settings already set a status line of their own. Needs bash.

ringStyle.title: Ring style
ringStyle.description: The symbol that stands in for the bar on a narrow line: nerd is Nerd Font circle slices in the forecast's colour (needs a Nerd Font), moon is moon-phase emoji in their own colours, circle is plain Unicode quarter circles in the forecast's colour, none shows no ring.
